payload.reason: The evidence indicates that IPA systems label data by interacting with users and automatically assigning labels based on user input and predefined actions.

claims.text: IPA systems augment resources with structured and labeled training data by interacting with users, which helps in further implementation of learnable dialogue components.
User inputs are automatically labeled with corresponding next actions and dialogue IDs, eliminating the need for additional post-labeling.
The dialogue system uses a rule-based approach to label user inputs with the next action based on predefined classifications.
